DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Viral Hepatitis leading to Hepatic Encephalopathy.

The combination of markedly elevated transaminases (AST/ALT >1000), significant hyperbilirubinemia, coagulopathy, and elevated ammonia levels, in the setting of agitation and confusion, is diagnostic of acute liver failure. Given the pattern of injury and clinical presentation, viral etiology is the primary suspicion.
